tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Page ground and the text colour on bone and line surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Raised dark surface: code blocks, screenshot windows, the active cell on Now.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Body text on ink, the lit state (active rail chip, hovered link row, lit layer), focus rings.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: The light band behind flow diagrams and the stack ticker. Text on it is ink or mute-ink.

tokens.name: bone-2
tokens.usage: Hover on the light CTA, shell borders inside a bone band, string tokens in code.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink: labels, captions, dates, breadcrumbs. 7.6:1 on ink.

tokens.name: mute-ink
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bone and line: labels inside the light band and lit rows. About 6:1 on bone.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every hairline: shell sides, cell dividers, chips, table rows. Decorative dividers, about 2.8:1 on ink, so never the only outline of a control.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-word
styles.usage: One per page, uppercase, font-stretch 125%. Sized to the frame (11.6cqi by default, fitted per name on case studies); 122px is the 1440px desktop size.

styles.name: page-head
styles.usage: Section heads across a page: clamp(34px, 5.4vw, 88px), uppercase, font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Sticky title beside a numbered case section: clamp(28px, 3vw, 50px), font-stretch 120%.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Next-link cards and flow step labels: clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px), font-stretch 118%.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Extraction output is useless if the interface makes it look settled.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph of a section: clamp(19px, 1.6vw, 23px), about 58ch wide.

styles.name: article
styles.sample: Someone deciding whether to exercise a notice window needs to know whether a date came out of a model or out of a person confirming it against the document.
styles.usage: Article prose in the reader, 68ch max. 17px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Product direction, architecture, implementation, testing, infrastructure, and release, across the whole stack.
styles.usage: List items and cell text in case studies.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Probabilistic extraction sits at the bottom of the stack, behind job contracts.
styles.usage: Diagram captions, screenshot captions, decision detail. Usually mute.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase index labels, breadcrumbs, dt terms, bracketed section numbers.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Stack and topic chips, sentence case, pill border in rule.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, the gap between stacked layers.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps: label to value, chevron to text, diagram head to body.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The minimum page gutter and every inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Cell and section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top padding of page section heads.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything boxed: cells, cards, frames, buttons. The system is square.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: All structure is drawn with 1px rules in rule (on ink) or ink (on bone).

tokens.name: stroke-progress
tokens.usage: Scroll progress lines under the nav, the chapter rail and contents links; focus outlines.
